convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 moving average indicators (iMA) with simple crossover entry/exit rules, fixed lot sizing, and no external .mqh libraries. All logic is straightforward and directly convertible.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one (close opposite side on signal reversal)

custom_logic_notes: EA detects new bar on each tick; signals are evaluated only once per new bar using previous completed bar values ([1]). On opposite signal, the existing position is closed first, then a new position is opened in the reverse direction. SL and TP are adjusted by factor of 10 for 5-digit brokers (or when _Point < 0.001) to normalize pip values across different digit configurations.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward dual-EMA crossover system. Key considerations: (1) Implement new-bar detection using bar timestamp comparison rather than MT5's IsNewBar pattern, (2) Use previous completed bar (shift=1) for signal evaluation to avoid repainting, (3) Digit adjustment logic translates to multiplying SL/TP pip values by 10 when symbol has 5 or 3 decimal places — in Python, detect this from symbol metadata, (4) Close-then-reverse logic must be atomic: close opposite position first, wait for fill confirmation, then open new position, (5) Fixed lot sizing is trivial to implement. No external indicator dependencies.
